{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
qa_orders_mask = data['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
filtered_data = data[~qa_orders_mask].copy()

# Check the number of rows after filtering
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA orders: {len(filtered_data)}")

# Check that converted == 1 for the filtered data
print(f"Number of converted orders (after filtering): {filtered_data['converted'].sum()}")"}
